svg.title: Clearway: what happens when the operator rejects an incident
svg.text: One click closes the alarm now and teaches the incident memory that this look, at this spot, is harmless.
board.py / notify.py → operator.jsonl → service.py → ledger.py (on_operator, _verdict) → alarms.py, tier0/change.py
② THE SERVICE TAKES IT IN
④ LATER: THE SAME THING AT THE SAME SPOT
is not read back by Clearway:
one line appended per click, via board or ntfy
the service's ticker reads new lines every 1 s
• no category yet (pending), or merged away
• already rejected: a later Confirm is refused too
• the run has ended (the board refuses first)
the alarm, In progress after the Confirm,
final: a later Confirm is refused,
and it can no longer recur or reopen
up to 8 looks, kept with this camera and box,
"Rejected by the operator …: not an incident."
if still open; the owner gets a quiet "Rejected" push
the slow background takes the object in,
so the same spot is not reported again
asked before the Reject, answered after it:
same category → joins the rejected card,
A new change at the same spot
a new question, one Hafnia request
held as a look-alike of the rejected card
one request, linked to the rejected card
no card, no alarm; its looks rejected too
rejected by Hafnia; the spot is released
a different problem still gets through
Params (clearway/ledger.py): recur_sim 0.85 · min_overlap 0.3 · escalate_s 30 · keep_embs 8 · the service's ticker every 1 s
